extraction.notes: Official Gazette text of the Aliens Act, NN 130/2011, in Croatian. The law was screened by keyword for EEA and EU national provisions, and Chapter X and the final provisions read. Text-file page numbers are PDF page numbers. Only claims on access to employment for EU workers in Croatia were extracted (RI-FMW-001, LIM-0026). Pass 1 does not assign issues. Residence procedure, family members and permanent stay provisions in Chapter X left out. Each quote is machine translated. Quotes keep the stray spaces of the converted text.

items.stated_text: Državljanin države članice EEP-a i članovi njegove obitelji, bez obzira jesu li državljani država članica EEP-a ili ne, a imaju pravo boravka u Republici Hrvatskoj, izjednačeni su u pravima s državljanima Republike Hrvatske u okviru odredbi Ugovora o funkcioniranju Europske unije.
items.translation_en: A national of an EEA Member State and his family members, whether or not they are nationals of EEA Member States, who have a right of residence in the Republic of Croatia, have equal rights with nationals of the Republic of Croatia within the provisions of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union.
items.summary: EEA nationals and family members with a right of residence have equal rights with Croatian nationals, within the Treaty on the Functioning of the EU.
items.extraction_note: Allowed by logged exception LIM-0027 (comparator documents from 2007 onwards on RI-FMW-001 for Croatia). Croatian text with machine translation; Croatian is not named in language limit LIM-0012, for the analyst at G2b. Status adopted reflects the published 2011 text only; later amendments (NN 74/13 and after) were not checked here. Enters into force on accession under Art. 238.

pass2.classification_note: country_response: Equal rights with nationals for EEA nationals with a right of residence; Art. 238 defers this to accession.

items.stated_text: Državljanin države članice EEP-a i članovi njegove obitelji mogu u Republici Hrvatskoj raditi i pružati usluge bez dozvole za boravak i rad, odnosno bez potvrde o prijavi rada.
items.translation_en: A national of an EEA Member State and his family members may work and provide services in the Republic of Croatia without a stay and work permit or a work registration certificate.
items.summary: EEA nationals and family members may work and provide services in Croatia without a stay and work permit or work registration certificate.
items.extraction_note: Allowed by logged exception LIM-0027 (comparator documents from 2007 onwards on RI-FMW-001 for Croatia). Croatian text with machine translation; Croatian is not named in language limit LIM-0012, for the analyst at G2b. Status adopted reflects the published 2011 text only; later amendments (NN 74/13 and after) were not checked here. Enters into force on accession under Art. 238.

pass2.classification_note: country_response: Work without a permit for EEA nationals, deferred to accession.

items.stated_text: Državljani država članica Europske unije nisu dužni ispunjavati uvjete iz ovoga članka.
items.translation_en: Nationals of European Union Member States are not required to meet the conditions of this Article.
items.summary: Before accession, nationals of EU Member States need not meet the conditions in this article on permits outside the quota.
items.extraction_note: Allowed by logged exception LIM-0027 (comparator documents from 2007 onwards on RI-FMW-001 for Croatia). Croatian text with machine translation; Croatian is not named in language limit LIM-0012, for the analyst at G2b. Status adopted reflects the published 2011 text only; later amendments (NN 74/13 and after) were not checked here. Art. 237(1) states that this paragraph ceases to apply on accession.

pass2.classification_note: country_response: Pre-accession relief from permit conditions for EU nationals; ceases on accession under Art. 237(1).

items.stated_text: U skladu s odredbama Ugovora o pristupanju Republike Hrvatske Europskoj uniji, Vlada Republike Hrvatske može i nakon pristupanja Hrvatske Europskoj uniji uredbom propisati primjenu pravila o radu državljana država članica Europske unije i članova njihovih obitelji koje su na snazi do trenutka potpisivanja Ugovora o pristupanju, u odnosu na državljane onih država članica koje će primjenjivati nacionalne mjere ili mjere koje proizlaze iz dvostranih sporazuma, za vrijeme trajanja primjene takvih mjera.
items.translation_en: In accordance with the provisions of the Treaty of Accession of the Republic of Croatia to the European Union, the Government of the Republic of Croatia may, also after Croatia’s accession to the European Union, by regulation prescribe the application of the rules on the work of nationals of European Union Member States and their family members in force up to the time of signing the Treaty of Accession, in respect of nationals of those Member States that will apply national measures or measures arising from bilateral agreements, for the duration of the application of such measures.
items.summary: After accession the Government may by regulation keep pre-signature work rules for nationals of Member States applying national or bilateral measures, while those last.

pass2.classification_note: country_response: Power to keep earlier rules for nationals of restricting Member States.

items.stated_text: Odredbe članka 47. stavka 5., članka 76. stavka 1. točke 2. i članka 78. stavka 5. ovoga Zakona prestaju važiti danom pristupanja Republike Hrvatske Europskoj uniji.
items.translation_en: The provisions of Article 47 paragraph 5, Article 76 paragraph 1 point 2 and Article 78 paragraph 5 of this Act cease to apply on the date of accession of the Republic of Croatia to the European Union.
items.summary: Articles 47(5), 76(1) point 2 and 78(5) of the Act cease to apply on the date of Croatia’s EU accession.

pass2.classification_note: country_response: Provisions that fall away on accession, part of the sequencing of the reform.

items.stated_text: Ovaj Zakon objavit će se u »Narodnim novinama«, a stupa na snagu 1. siječnja 2012. osim odredbi: članka 21., članka 22. stavka 1. točke 5. i stavka 2. u dijelu koji se odnosi na prikupljanje i uništavanje biometrijskih podataka; članka 47. stavka 1. točke 6. i stavka 3., članka 64. stavka 3., članka 86. do članka 89., članka 110., članka 115., članka 117., članka 119., članka 120. do članka 122., članka 132. stavka 2., članka 135., članka 153. do članka 203., članka 207. stavka 4., 5. i 7., članka 221., članka 223., članka 227. i članka 228. ovoga Zakona, koje stupaju na snagu danom pristupanja Republike Hrvatske Europskoj uniji.
items.translation_en: This Act shall be published in the Official Gazette and shall enter into force on 1 January 2012, except for the provisions of: Article 21, Article 22 paragraph 1 point 5 and paragraph 2 in the part relating to the collection and destruction of biometric data; Article 47 paragraph 1 point 6 and paragraph 3, Article 64 paragraph 3, Articles 86 to 89, Article 110, Article 115, Article 117, Article 119, Articles 120 to 122, Article 132 paragraph 2, Article 135, Articles 153 to 203, Article 207 paragraphs 4, 5 and 7, Article 221, Article 223, Article 227 and Article 228 of this Act, which enter into force on the date of accession of the Republic of Croatia to the European Union.
items.summary: The Act enters into force on 1 January 2012, except listed provisions including Articles 153 to 203, which enter into force on EU accession.

pass2.classification_note: country_response: Commencement: the EU workers chapter starts only on accession.

items.stated_text: Stupanjem na snagu ovoga Zakona prestaje važiti Zakon o strancima (»Narodne novine«, br. 79/07. i 36/09.).
items.translation_en: On the entry into force of this Act, the Aliens Act (Official Gazette Nos. 79/07 and 36/09) ceases to apply.
items.summary: NN 130/2011 repeals the earlier Aliens Act, NN 79/07 and 36/09.
